The '''Kamgeddon system''' was located in the [[Harron sector/Legends|Harron sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']],<ref name="Ootmian" /> which connected it to the [[Belasco system/Legends|Belasco system]]<ref name="EGTW" />&mdash;a part of the eponymous [[Belasco sector/Legends|Belasco sector]]<ref name="EAOC" />&mdash;and the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Prindaar system/Legends|Prindaar system]].<ref name="EGTW" />

During the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], the Kamgeddon [[Star system/Legends|system]] was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and shared its name with the ''[[Glory of Kamgeddon]]'', a [[cathedral ship]] of the Republic's [[Pius Dea]] cult.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kamgeddon system was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed it in grid square O-12.<ref name="EAOC" />
